messages:
nina: ok the unofficial snack-table heist saga continues. who stealth-nabbed the blue cupcakes? :eyes:
omar: guilty-ish. i thought they were labeled 'for presenters' and also i was weak. :cupcake:
leah: omar!!! we have a code of conduct for cupcakes, apparently unwritten but very real. :clipboard:
trent: evidence: crumb trail + glitter on keyboard (confetti from earlier). forensic team assembled. :mag:
sasha: confession: i tried to leave a ransom note but it turned into a dad joke: 'i donut know what you're talking about' :doughnut: (it was peak)
nina: that joke deserves its own award. proposing a new all-hands micro-award: "Best Dad Joke in Crisis"
omar: i nominate sasha for the award and also offer to be her crime partner in future heists.
sam-bot: reminder: recording is live and is available at https://drive.example.com/all-hands/1789990001.mp4 :movie_camera:
leah: tiny poll: do we want a mid-all-hands snack break next time? a) yes b) no c) only if cupcakes are labeled d) only if cupcakes are shared equitably
trent: voting yes. snacks = morale. also we need a designated cupcake guardian next time.
sasha: also shoutout to facilities for the lemon bars. stealthy and delicious. :lemon:
omar: also follow-up: if you're going to label cupcakes 'for presenters', make the label physically larger and possibly threatening.
nina: idea: cardboard crown for the person who brings the most elaborate snack. winner gets to wear it in the recording.
sam-bot: transcript uploaded: https://drive.example.com/all-hands/1789990001.txt
leah: favorite quote nomination: "we have a code of conduct for cupcakes" — immediately engraving that on a sticker
sasha: planner note: next all-hands i'll bring an offering of tiny biscotti as penance.
trent: and i'll bring a tiny trophy for dad jokes. engraving suggestions welcome.
omar: final note: i will return the cupcakes' dignity by bringing ethically sourced muffins next time.
nina: closing: you all make work delightful. also, label your baked goods. :sparkles:
